source: This also explains why FLOP count alone is a poor runtime predictor. Two implementations can perform similar arithmetic but generate different memory traffic. A workload’s data movement is part of its execution algorithm, even when the mathematical expression on paper does not mention memory at all.
zh: 这也解释了为什么单独的 FLOP 计数是一个很差的运行时间预测器。两种实现可以执行类似的算术，但生成不同的内存流量。工作负载的数据移动是其执行算法的一部分，即使纸上的数学表达式根本没有提到内存。
